Structures-Survival Engineer said about it: I take from the Collegiate Wind Challenge 2023 - University of Colorado - Design Report (E18) that competition tower practice is 1.5 inch outer diameter, 1/8 inch thick 6061 aluminium tubing, which I use for the post; the post tip deflection (E26) is 0.516 mm against 25.0 mm side clearance, and the bending stress (E27) is 16.6 megapascals (MPa) against 240 MPa yield for 6061-T6 aluminium from the thin-wall-aluminium-frame-sizing skill (E21), a factor of about 14.
